title: Cinnamomum verum tea for medicinal use
intro: Cinnamomum verum tea is a traditional herbal preparation made from the leaves of the cinnamon tree, known for its aromatic and warming properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to support digestive health, ease respiratory congestion, and promote circulation. The tea is often consumed to help manage symptoms of colds, flu, and gastrointestinal discomfort. It may also be used externally as a topical application for muscle pain or inflammation. In many cultures, it is valued not only for its medicinal benefits but also for its pleasant flavor and aromatic qualities.
